typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @STARTDATE DATETIME DECLARE @ENDDATE DATETIME  SELECT @ENDDATE = GETDATE() SELECT @STARTDATE = DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, getdate()), 0)  SELECT M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 		AND CL.CALLLIST_CD = \'303\' 		AND CONVERT(DATE,CASE WHEN DATEPART(HOUR,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE)>22 THEN DATEADD(DAY,1,CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE) ELSE CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE END) BETWEEN @STARTDATE AND @ENDDATE 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID 		AND CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ACTIVE_IND = 0 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID 		AND ICR.CALLLISTRULE_CD = \'DELSFHN303\' 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID= M.MEMBER_IID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> PDSSFHNMembers
PDSSFHNMembers sink(input(
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		SUBSCRIBER_ID = MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER)) ~> SFHNExtractFlatFile
